comparison.objective: Extract a drawer completely past an anti-pull-out stop, not tune or lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Drawer pulling plus stop-clearing manipulation versus recessed tool alignment, collar adjustment, bimanual stabilization, and torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Drawer fully removed past the stop; body is empty and no spec versions or damage/force rubric are available. Candidate requires relocking and repeated safe impacts.
comparison.reason: Stop negotiation during extraction is meaningfully different from calibrated damping and setting-retention verification.
